description:
Stop tracking a competitor for an extension.

Stops the store fetches. The recorded history is kept, so adding the
same competitor again later restores its charts rather than starting
from zero — and its positions carry on being observed either way,
because they come from searches this account already runs.

Needs an ExtensionDash account: sign in from your app, e.g. `claude mcp login extensions-dashboard` or `codex mcp login extensions-dashboard`.
name: remove_competitor
title: Remove competitor
